༄༅/ /gza' yum gyi dbang khrus zab mo bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gza' yum gyi dbang khrus zab mo bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsod dus 'dir dam nyams dang tshul 'chos mang ba'i nyes pas drang srong gi gnod pas 'tshe ba'i phyir/ de'i gnyen por gza' yum dbyings phyug ma'i sgrub thabs ni/ gnas dben par mchod gtor bshams/ stan bde bar 'dug la sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang*/ skyabs sems spyi 'gro ltar byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po'i ze'u 'brur zla ba'i gdan la rang sems e yig dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dbyings phyug mu kha le srid gsum rgyal mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gcer bu dbu skra bcings pa'i lhag ma rgyab tu grol ba/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa spyan gsum dmar la 'khrugs pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub la me 'bar ba/ nu ma 'bur zhing lang tsho rgyas la sgeg cing ldems pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rab tu 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i 'od dmar po'i klong na phyed skyil du bzhugs pa'i bha ga gsang ba'i nang du rā hu la dud kha mgo dgu ral pa'i khrod nas bya rog tong tong gi sgra sgrog pa/ phyag bzhi dang po gnyis rwa yi mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ 'og ma gnyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mgo lus thams cad mig stong 'bar ba/ sku stod srin po khros pa/ sku smad dug sbrul 'khyil ba/ lus bdud kyi lang tsho can/ lha mo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su e yig dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ khri ma khri a pu swā hā/ de'i mthar/ gza' dang sde brgyad kyi sngags/ gza' kha tra ru tra ya a la ma phra du te sha na la swā hā/ de'i sngags phreng gnyis po dmar me re re 'khor ba'i 'od kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo ye shes pa spyan drangs/ e/ dpal ldan lha mo srid gsum dbang phyug ma// dregs pa pho mo ma lus 'dul mdzad ma// dran pas bde ster nad gdon zhi mdzad ma// 'gro la brtse bas tshur byon brtan par bzhugs// oṃ ma hā dhā tu i shwa rī mu kha li sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ khri ma khri a pu sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ khri ma khri a pu i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi/ bdag mdun spyi la 'bul/ oṃ rā hu la ba sha me ki i daṃ ba ling+ta khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis drang srong la 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ thugs rje gzi 'od ldan pas sa gsum gyi// nyams chag mun nag stug po gcig char 'joms// 'phral dang yun gyi bde mchog pad dkar tshal// rab rgyas byed ma khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas bzlas pa ni/ lha mo'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng rang sgra sgrog pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i tshe lha mo dang rā hu la la phog /zhal nas sngags bzla bzhin pa las lha mo'i sku las bdud rtsi bab rā hu la bde ba'i nyams skyes shing gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur/ bsam pa'i ngang*| oṃ khri ma khri a pu swā hā/ 'bum phrag brgyad grangs tshad yin/ gza' kha tra ru tra la a ya ma phra du te sha na la swā hā/ 'bum phrag gsum bzlas so// bdag bskyed do// yang rjes gnang byed na gdan gtsang ma'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba rin po che'i bum pa chus bkang ba'i dbus su bum rdzas ni/ tsan+dan dkar po/ de ba da ru/ rgya shug /ru rta/ rtsod/ til dkar po/ gi waṃ/ gur gum/ cu gang*/ ga pu+ur/ gu gul nag po/ rma bya'i mdongs/ ha sa de ba rnams phye ma byas la btab/ ba dmar po'i 'o ma bsres/ mgul chings dmar po rma bya'i sgro'i kha rgyan btsug /mthar mchod pa dang dmar gtor bsham/ bdag bskyed sogs gong ltar bsgrubs rjes/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang lasaṃ bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du paṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po ze'u 'brur zla ba'i gdan la e yig dmar po las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/

dbyings phyug mu kha le sogs gong ma bzhin mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar sngar ltar las/ rā hu la la phog bde pa'i nyams dang ldan/ de gnyis sku las bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang*/ sde brgyad kyi nad gdon dug thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ sngags gong ma ci mang bzla zhing sngags 'og ma yang skabs su bzla/ bum lha zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur/ las bum bsgrub pa bdag 'jug blang ba sogs ji ltar rigs par bya'o// rjes gnang dngos la slob ma khrus byas bral la 'god/ bgegs bskrad/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dbyings phyug mu kha le srid gsum rgyal mo'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la dbyings phyug mu kha le'i// dbang dang rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /bar lan gsum/ de nas lha bsgom du gzhug pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po'i ze'u 'brur zla ba'i gdan la/ e yig dmar po las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag dang slob ma dbyings phyug mu kha le srid gsum rgyal mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gcer bu dbu skra bcings pa'i lhag ma rgyab tu grol ba zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dmar la 'khrugs pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub la me 'bar ba/ nu ma 'bur zhing lang tsho rgyas pa sgeg cing ldems pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rab tu 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa 'od dmar po'i klong na phyed skyil bzhugs pa'i bha ga gsang ba'i nang du rā hu la dud kha mgo dgu ral pa'i khrod nas bya rog gi dbu yis tong tong gi sgra sgrog pa/

phyag bzhi dang po gnyis rwa yi mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ 'og ma gnyis chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang zhags pa/ mgo lus thams cad mig stong 'bar ba/ stod srin po khros pa/ smad dug sbrul 'khyil ba/ lus bdud kyi lang tsho can/ lha mo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su e yig dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ khri ma khri a pu swā hā/ de'i mthar gza' kha tra ru tra ya a ya ma phra du te sha na la swā hā/ de'i sngags phreng gnyis dmar me re re 'khor ba'i 'od kyis rang bzhin gnas nas lha mo ye shes pa spyan drangs nas slob ma la thim par gyur/ oṃ/ dpal ldan lha mo srid gsum dbang phyug ma// dregs pa pho mo ma lus 'dul mdzad ma// dran pas bde ster nad gdon zhi mdzad ma// 'gro la brtse bas tshur byon brtan par bzhugs// oṃ ma hā dhā tu i shwa rī mu kha le sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ā we sha ya a āḥ gnyis su med par bsam/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ rgya gram gyis bkab par byas te dbang bskur ba ni/ bum pa mgor bzhag pa/ e/ srid pa kun yum 'gro la sman mdzad ma// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma// dbyings phyug srid rgyal sku yi byin rlabs las// lus kyi nad gdon bar chad zhi gyur cig /oṃ khri ma khri a pu swā hā/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ bum chu sbyin/ yang bla mas bdud rtsi mgrin par bzhag la/ e/ srid pa kun yum 'gro la sman mdzad ma// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma// dbyings phyug srid rgyal gsung gi byin rlabs las| |ngag gi nad gdon bar chad zhi gyur cig /sngags sham du/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ bum pa'am rdo rje snying khar bzhag la/ e/ srid pa kun yum 'gro la sman mdzad pa// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma// dbyings phyug srid rgyal thugs kyi byin rlabs las// yid kyi nad gdon thams cad zhi gyur cig /rtsa sngags sham du/ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

de nas gong 'og gi sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin par bya/ slar gtor ma thogs la/ e/ srid gsum bdag mo dbyings phyug mu kha le// yum chen ma mo dregs pa 'dul ba'i gtso// rdo rje sku gsung thugs kyi dbang sbyin pas// rdo rje slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la// phyi bdud gza' dang gdong mo ro langs dang*// sha za myos byed rjed byed 'byung po'i tshogs// bar chad nad dang nyer 'tshe zhi gyur cig /oṃ khri ma khri a pu swā hā/ gza' kha tra ru tra ya a ya ma phra du te sha na la swā hā/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ bla ma brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje/ mkhas pa shrī siṃ ha/ mkhas pa bi ma la mi tra/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan| lo chen bai ro tsa na la sogs pa rnying ma brgyud pa thams cad dang*/ bya khyung pa ngag dbang pad+ma rnam rgyal/ rgyal dbang pad+ma bstan 'dzin/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa sogs nye brgyud bla ma brgyud pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ sngags gong 'og dang bcas pa brjod la rjes su dam tshig bsrung bar khas blang ba dang*/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' ston 'bul ba sogs gzhan rigs ltar bya'o/// / ༈ /yang gzer nad phog pa la khrus dang*/ byab pa dang*/ srung ba byed na zhag gsum mam bdun sogs bum sgrub byas la/ rmi lam du khrus byas pa/ nyi ma shar ba/ dngos su bum chu khol ba sogs rtags mthong nas lha bum bzhu la| dbang gong ltar bskur ba'i mthar bum chus nad pa bkrus la 'di skad do// e/ srid pa kun gyi yum gcig ma// 'gro ba kun la sman par mdzad/ */legs nyes kun gyi stangs 'dzin ma// dam tshig kun gyi rjes gcod ma// mu kha le ni dbyings kyi mchog /sems can kun la bde ster ma// bdud rtsi bcud kyi nang bzhugs shing*// zhal nas 'byung ba lnga 'char ma// khyod kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs mthus// phyi bdud gza' dang ro langs dang*// sha za myos byed rjed byed sogs// 'byung po'i gdon gyis btab pa rnams// thams cad zhi dang grol bar mdzod// mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa'i dug

/kha rlangs dug dang bsam ngan dug /kun kyang byang zhing dag gyur nas// lus sems bcings pa las thar nas// nyi zla gza' las grol ba ltar// rnam grol bde legs phun tshogs shog /pra ma rā dza ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ pra ma kā la ya phya hūm̐ druṃ// de bdat+te badz+ra hūm̐ druṃ// nad gdon thams cad zhi ba dang*/ phyi ru thon cing srung ba dang*| |rab tu srung bar gyis shig /slar gong gi tshigs bcad sngags bcas la zhi ba'i mal du byab pa dang srungs shig bsgyur la/ rma bya'i sgros byab pa dang*/ slar bum pa gnas gsum du gtugs shing gong gi tshigs bcad sngags bcas kyi mthar| sngar gyi bzlas pa'i sngags btags la bsrung ngo*// rjes mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ bkra shis/ bsngo smon spyi 'gros ltar bya'o// de ltar dbang khrus cho ga 'di ni gza' nad can la nyin re bzhin du bya ba'am dus gnyan rnams su bgyis na gza' nad gdong thug pa'i nad kyang dngos su 'tsho zhing slar brgyal mi srid/ rang srung bdag bskyed ma chag pa'i ngang nas/ nyin zhag rer sngags gnyis sbrel ba nyer gcig yan ma chag na/ steng gdon la sogs 'byung po ma lus srung ba'i mchog go| |dbang khrus nyin re bzhin byed na tha ma'i nyin ma gtogs par gshegs bsdu mi bya/ gza' nad can la dug phyung byed na dmar gtor de dang lha gnyis su med par gsal ba slob ma'i gnas gsum du dbang bskur ba'i tshe lha mo'i bha ga'i nang gi drang srong gi sku las 'od 'phros nad pa la phog pas gza'i dug thams cad 'od des blangs nas kho rang sku la 'ub 'ub thim par bsam pa ni bla na med pa'i gnad yin no/ /smras pa/ gnam lcags 'bar ba rab lhung tshe/ /gdengs can dbang po mes gum ltar| |gza' gdon dregs pa'i gdug rtsub kyang*// gza' yum khro mo gcig gis nyams// de phyir 'di yi 'jigs pa rnams// gso srung gyi na kun spong la// man ngag 'di dag dang du longs// dge bas 'gro rnams mchog thob shog

/de ltar 'di'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang bum chog dang bcas pa 'di'ang dus mtha'i sems can rmongs pa rnams la steng gdon gyis 'tshe ba'i gnyen por yig cha khungs ma rnams nas bsdus te/ 'bri gung chos kyi grags pas spro lung gzim chung lcang lo can gsang sngags kyi gan mdzod chen por bris pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
